component.name: MultiPak
component.summary: Install different package formats and manage your applications
Instale diferentes formatos de pacotes e gerencie seus aplicativos

description.p: MultiPak was developed to make installing different Linux package formats on Bazzite easier and more consistent. It brings RPM, DEB, compiled Arch Linux packages and AppImages together in a single graphical workflow, reducing the need to learn a separate installation process for each format.
